item.title: How I Deployed My Blog on GitHub Pages Using Hugo
item.author: your@email.com (Dennis Thiong'o)
item.description:
So you want a blog. Not just any blog — a fast, free, fully custom one that you actually own. That is exactly what I built, and in this post I will walk you through every step I took to get this site live on GitHub Pages using Hugo.

What is Hugo?

Hugo is a static site generator. Instead of a heavy CMS like WordPress, Hugo takes your content written in simple Markdown files and converts them into a full website in milliseconds. No database. No server. Just fast, clean HTML.
